source.snippet: The real edge here would be supporting mobile development builds on real devices, is this on your roadmap and if so what's your plan to support it? In that case I would pay for this if you handled the real device on your end.

problem_statement: AI-powered automated testing agents for mobile apps on real physical devices are unavailable as a managed service; developers must self-host complex device farms or skip mobile testing entirely, leading to undetected bugs in production.
target_segment: Mobile app developers and QA engineers at startups and mid-size software companies shipping iOS/Android apps
notes: Commenter explicitly stated 'I would pay for this if you handled the real device on your end' — clear willingness-to-pay signal. The gap is managed real-device testing infra bundled with AI agents. Momentic (YC W24) covers web but commenter sees mobile as the defensible differentiator. Buyer profile: dev/QA lead at a startup, likely already paying for CI/CD and some testing tooling.
